turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today, we'll discuss your upcoming laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Let's start with your medical history. Can you tell me why you're having this surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doctor. Yeah, I've been having belly pains on the right side, especially after eating. The scans showed gallstones, so they said to remove the gallbladder.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Now, let's go through your medications. You're on amlodipine, atorvastatin, omeprazole, and metformin, correct? And I see metformin was stopped recently?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, doctor. I take amlodipine for blood pressure, atorvastatin for cholesterol, omeprazole for the acid reflux, and metformin for diabetes. But they told me to stop metformin a few days before surgery, right?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Correct. We'll monitor your blood sugar closely. Now, about allergies—your records say 'no known allergies,' but I always double-check. Have you ever had any reactions to medications, especially antibiotics like penicillin?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Oh, wait a minute... I think I had a rash once when I took penicillin for a infection. It was years ago, but my skin turned all red and itchy. I told the doctor then, but maybe it wasn't recorded properly?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for mentioning that. We'll note the penicillin allergy clearly. Even if it was a rash, we'll avoid penicillin and related antibiotics. Any other reactions to foods, latex, or other drugs?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, just that one time with penicillin. I don't think there's anything else.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Let's confirm your NPO status—have you had anything to eat or drink since midnight?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. My wife made sure I fasted properly. Just a bit of water with my morning meds, but that was hours ago.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Have you had anesthesia before? Any issues with previous surgeries or procedures?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Once, for a hernia repair. I woke up with a sore throat, but otherwise it was fine. No vomiting or anything bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Noted. Lastly, how's your overall fitness? Can you walk up stairs or do daily activities without excessive shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yeah, I walk to the MRT station daily. Climbing stairs is okay, though I get a bit tired if I rush. No chest pains or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. We'll plan for general anesthesia with an LMA, as discussed. Your blood pressure and GERD will be managed carefully. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. You've explained everything clearly. I'm ready to proceed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Wonderful. We'll see you in the operating theater. Take care, and we'll ensure your safety throughout.
